class.name: RealityClipping3D
class.brief_description: Clips the visual content of its parent's subtree to a box on visionOS.
class.description: This wraps RealityKit's [url=https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ClippingComponent]ClippingComponent[/url]. Add a RealityClipping3D as a child of a Node3D to clip that node and all of its descendants to a box centered on the RealityClipping3D. Only one RealityClipping3D is supported per parent.

members.member: Whether to feather (fade out) content near the edges of the clipping box, instead of clipping it with a hard edge.
The falloff curve used for the feathered edge, when [member feather_enabled] is [code]true[/code].
The distance, per axis, from each face of the clipping box over which content fades out, when [member feather_enabled] is [code]true[/code].
Size of the clipping box, centered on the RealityClipping3D. There is a gizmo displaying the box in the editor, so that you can preview what is inside and outside the box.

constants.constant: Content fades out linearly across the feathered edge.
Content fades out following a cubic curve across the feathered edge.
